item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the 2% skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"brief_complete":false,"completion_reason":"Three material architecture and integration boundaries remain unresolved.","questions":[{"decision_key":"provider_adapter_contract","label":"Provider contract","context":"Direct, LAN mesh, and PeerJS providers need one predictable integration boundary.","question":"What contract should every provider implement?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"One normalized invoke, health, cancel, and result contract"},{"number":2,"text":"Separate contracts for each provider transport"},{"number":3,"text":"A minimal invoke contract with optional capabilities"}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":94},{"decision_key":"work_to_workflow_context_handoff","label":"Context handoff","context":"Conversation memory and workflow execution memory must remain isolated.","question":"How should Work context enter a workflow run?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Copy an immutable versioned snapshot into the run"},{"number":2,"text":"Reference the live conversation context"},{"number":3,"text":"Require manual export and import"},{"number":4,"text":"Pass only an operator-selected message subset"}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":91},{"decision_key":"canonical_run_evidence_storage","label":"Evidence storage","context":"NexusCentral must preserve crash-safe immutable run evidence and artifacts.","question":"What should be the canonical run evidence store?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Transactional metadata plus content-addressed artifact files"},{"number":2,"text":"Filesystem manifests and artifact folders only"},{"number":3,"text":"All metadata and artifacts stored as database blobs"},{"number":4,"text":"An external artifact service as the source of truth"}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":88}]}
